name: GestureScale
summary: A two-hand pinch scales and rotates the polyhedron so a face is large enough to touch directly with a fingertip.
howItWorks: The scale follows the change in distance between the hands; the enlarged face is then touched. Tested with 16 participants selecting single faces on regular polyhedra (4, 6 or 12 faces, two sizes) with tracked hands.

relationships.note: Introduced with seven other face-selection techniques in the same study.
The study's baseline (DragRotate) rotates the object with one hand and selects with a hand ray.
